name: Spain: self-employed (autónomos) and small companies
currencyNote: Reserves are held in the token received (USDC or EURC); the user converts and pays in euros.
dueNote: Quarterly VAT (modelo 303) and income-tax prepayment (modelo 130) are filed in the first 20 days after each quarter, and until 30 January for the fourth quarter. The vault uses 30 days for every quarter; paying the tax earlier is always allowed.

presets.label: No VAT charged (exports, EU B2B reverse charge) + income-tax prepayment 20%

notes: The income-tax prepayment of modelo 130 is 20% of the quarter's net profit (income minus deductible expenses). Kyros reserves 20% of the taxable base of each payment, which is never less than what is due; the surplus is released after the due date.
Rule packs are information, not tax advice. The user confirms the percentages; the vault enforces what the user chose.

sources.title: Ley 37/1992 del IVA (tipos impositivos, arts. 90 y 91)
